cohort: 83 infertile patients with uterus didelphys who achieved clinical pregnancy after IVF/ICSI, matched with 249 controls with normal uterine morphology
finding: Women with uterus didelphys had significantly increased risk of preterm birth, cesarean section, and birth weight <2500 g in singleton pregnancies and increased risk of preterm delivery, perinatal mortality, and birth weight <2500 g in twin pregnancies compared to women with normal uterine morphology.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common in women with uterus didelphys compared to those with normal uterine morphology.
birth_weight: Birth weight was recorded as <2500 g or >=2500 g
